budget_note: 1 ns per record: the design rule in 17.4 -- once the extra cost of dyn exceeds this, the type set should be fixed and dyn moved off the hot path
rule: U <= B accept | L > B reject | else insufficient-evidence
diff_convention: diff = B(dyn) - A(monomorphized generic), ns per record; positive means the dyn path costs more

bootstrap.method: percentile bootstrap of the paired mean difference

cases.rule: U<=B accept; L>B reject; otherwise insufficient-evidence
